checks.title: uiux human approval and source traceability
evidence: Required/excluded sections and chosen output type
Actual editable file or preview evidence; unavailable tools and substitutions disclosed
Canonical DESIGN.md or existing design master path/revision read by implementer and reviewer
Contextual typography, density, content and layout rationale; no imposed universal aesthetic
Actual viewport/interaction findings, fixes and rechecks; build success is not visual approval
External skill/provider commit and prerequisite evidence, or explicit NOT_RUN/BLOCKED fallback
